The main takeaway from our work is that
GIC activity depends not only on the geomagnetic storm intensity but also on the storm phase, interplanetary drivers and on the local ground magnetic field.
GIC activity is driven by the interplay between the storm drivers and the storm phase.
GIC activity is a complex phenomenon that requires a detailed analysis of the storm phase and the interplanetary driver to be fully understood.
